---
title: "Notice Patterns"
---

## Observe before explaining

Suppose three people arrive at a library at 09:00, 09:05, and 09:05.
Two arrivals have the same recorded time. That is an observation. Saying that
the two people travelled together would be an explanation that needs more evidence.

## Check your understanding

Which statement is supported by the recorded times: two people arrived at 09:05,
or two people are friends? Explain your choice before opening the feedback.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Feedback"}
Two people arrived at 09:05. The arrival times do not tell us whether they are friends.
:::

Try writing one observation and one possible explanation for something you notice
nearby. You can do this on paper or your phone.
